title: Emmett Hardy, Walter Holzhaus and Charlie Teagarden
summary: Brownlee rates Hardy and Walter Holzhaus (from San Antonio, who could play two tones at once) and mentions Charlie Teagarden and Ray Baduc with Jimmy Dorsey.
